options.label: Tell me who this app is for and what problem it solves
options.description: Before we build anything, let's be clear on two things: who is going to use this, and what frustration or problem does it fix for them? Write 2-3 sentences answering both questions.

options.label: Describe what your app does in one sentence
options.description: If someone asked you what your app does at a party, what would you say? Keep it short — no technical words needed. Just the thing it does and who it helps.

options.label: Pick the one feature to build first
options.description: Out of everything you want this app to do, which one feature would make someone say 'yes, I need this'? Focus there first — everything else can wait.
